title: Ruth as a type of the Gentiles and the legal problem of her entry
english: The second was named Ruth. Ruth bears a type of the Gentiles, because she left her ancestral ways behind and was joined to the Israelite way of life. But it must be inquired how Ruth, who was a Moabite, entered the assembly of God when the law forbids a Moabite to enter the assembly of God. And in inquiring into this, apply the saying: "The law is not laid down for the righteous, but for the lawless and disobedient" (1 Timothy 1:9).
